title: The small-amplitude Gaussian-smoothed flat block has a positive leading gap

sign_classification.shell_constants: Assume a_0N<=omega_k<=a_1N and c_0N^3<=d_N<=c_1N^3 on the selected complete cube.
sign_classification.positive_lower: Since 0<s_(N,k)^*<=1 and s_(0,k)<s_(N,k)^*, C_(F,N)>=(eta/(2N))sum omega_k^2>=(a_0^2c_0/2)eta N^4.
sign_classification.threshold: For fixed eta below both covariance positivity and a_0^2c_0/(6gc_1^2), K1653 and K1637 give Q_N[Law(X_N)]-lambda_N^statG>=c_(g,eta)N^4 for all sufficiently large cubic stages.
sign_classification.scope_guard: This classifies sufficiently small fixed amplitudes in the K1648 family only. Larger amplitudes, other angular laws, unrestricted coefficient convergence and bounded-error recentering remain open.
